posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked:
Missingno:

Okay so Revo has the best deck manipulation in the game and ongoing busting out the wazoo. If anyone was winning here, it was them. Nature winning makes a bit of sense on account of how dang durable that team is even with all the setup blowup. How the heck did Void Gaurd and Space make it through this?

Space won with The Sentinels as the last hero standing. Both Sky-scraper and KNYFE have “1 hero may use a power” incaps which meant Mainstay could get 3 blocks per round. The Sentinels were able to chip Miss Info down with their damage dealing one-shots and The Slumbering Serpent helped as well.
Void Guard won thanks to Dr. Medico keeping everyone alive and Void Slave helping keep Clues out of play.

In general, the environment was a huge factor. Freedom 5 had great cards and would have been in position to be competitive; but a round 1 Savana Noctura led to Legacy, Bunker, and Absolute Zero all going down on the second villain turn.

posts.cooked:
How Oblivaeon will work.

1. I'll use the same shield for all teams for each difficulty - choosen at random, but with no repeats, such that 4/5 will be used between the 4 difficulties... unless Oblivaeon's Challenge rule ends up involving multiple shields.

2. Environments will be choosen at random with no repeats... Time Cataclysm must be used as one of the 20 environments since it will have 1 less use than the other environments once the remaining 10 non-oblivaeon battles are completed.

3. The 5 environments selected for each battle will be used in order.

4. Each team has been assigned 20 thematic backup heroes to be used in order (as eligible). The backup heroes were assigned by assigning each team all variants of their heroes first in release order, and then populating the rest based on theme using each variant exactly once (except Completionist Guise who will only be used for team Nature). Also, I avoided repeats of the same hero's variant on any team other than its own. If I run out of thematic backups I'll start hitting the random button.
